title: Run a paid customer acquisition experiment
summary: When a defined customer segment and acquisition hypothesis are ready for a limited paid test. A reconciled experiment result with a documented continue, revise or stop decision.
outcomes: A reconciled experiment result with a documented continue, revise or stop decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a defined customer segment and acquisition hypothesis are ready for a limited paid test.

parts.title: Define the hypothesis and measurement plan
parts.guidance: State the segment, message, channel, desired action and attribution window. Record the baseline and separate leading indicators from actual revenue or retained customers.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve claims, targeting and spend
parts.guidance: The marketing owner approves the budget, creative claims and audience choices. Review privacy, advertising and platform restrictions for the intended markets and leave unsubstantiated claims out of the test.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Configure the approved campaign and tracking
parts.guidance: Authorized operators set spending limits, destinations and consent-aware measurement. Test the landing and payment journey and confirm a clear stop mechanism before launch.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Configure the approved campaign and tracking

parts.title: Monitor performance and data quality
parts.guidance: Reconcile spend, valid conversions and downstream customer outcomes. Investigate tracking gaps, fraud and support burden instead of optimizing only for clicks or a platform-reported conversion count.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review the commercial outcome
parts.guidance: Compare observed acquisition cost and customer value with the hypothesis and cash exposure. Approve any scaling separately, stop weak tests and document the evidence for the next experiment.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

verify.how: A reconciled experiment result with a documented continue, revise or stop decision.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
